title: Gauge
direction: Measured rhythm: a row of graduated scale bars whose heights trace an m
rationale: Markilo measures everything; a scale whose bar heights rise-fall-rise reads as m and as an instrument reading. Modular system.

sketchReview.notes: Two navy arches with an amber middle stem: reads m at once, survives 16 px, one-color safe if amber stem is a counter-gap. Fix: stem width equals outer stems, hairline gap to arch tuned so it holds at 16 px; make the arch junction/crown unique (not default Sora-like); drop ruler/scale talk, the stem is the measured thing. Avoid it looking like an m with a pasted bar; amber must stay a small share, not coral-like. s7 rejected: floating bar reads as i-dot (mi).

semantic-relevance.rationale: Gauge idea not visible; stem reads as battery or slot

memorability.rationale: Bump on inner arch is forgettable

typography.rationale: Bold untouched grotesk matches weight but no link

color.rationale: Same amber as overlap; rectangle looks like a placeholder

versatility.rationale: Fine in one color; inner detail clots at small size
